tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_phantom_lancer_spir: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
Azwraith's proficiency at spearing his family's meal of fish is proving quite useful in the battlefield.
Illusions within %fake_lance_distance% range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.
Spirit Lances from Phantom Lancer's illusions deal %illusion_lance_damage_pct%%% Lance Damage.
Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.

tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_phantom_lancer_dopp: Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. Dread Magus Vorn's death imbued the Phantom Lancer with the ability to bend and fracture all spectrums of light.
This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.
Spawns an additional illusion per %hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%% of health that Phantom Lancer is missing.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer_bio:
The remote village of Pole had no knowledge of the wars raging in the heart of the kingdom. For them, the quiet of spear fishing, and a family meal were all that a full life required. Yet war came for them nonetheless. Joining the able-bodied conscripts as they filed passed their homes, the humble lancer Azwraith vowed to bring peace to his kingdom, and in so doing, his people. Placed with his kin in the vanguard of the final assault against the Dread Magus Vorn, the cost to his fellows was absolute. As the charging force battled toward the fortress, Azwraith alone among his kind remained standing, and he alone was able to infiltrate the keep.

Focused and infuriated by the slaughter of his brothers, Azwraith bested each of the wizard's deadly traps and conjured guardians. Soon the simple fisherman arrived at Vorn's tower sanctum. The pair dueled through the night, pike to staff, as chaos raged below, and with a deafening cry Azwraith pierced his enemy. But the wizard did not simply expire; he exploded into uncountable shards of light, penetrating his killer with power. As the dust settled and the smoke of combat began to clear, Azwraith found himself standing among a throng of his kin. Each seemed to be dressed as he was, each seemed armed as he was, and he could sense that each thought as he did. Aware that his allies were approaching, he willed these phantoms to hide themselves, and one by one they began to vanish into nothingness. As the soldiers came upon the sanctum, they found the warrior that had bested the wizard. When they approached their champion, the lancer vanished. The pikeman who had stood before them was no more than another phantom.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer_hype: Phantom Lancer storms enemy forces with an endless supply of clones. Leading his illusory army, he can cut foes apart in a breathtaking flurry of attacks, send clones to push into enemy territory, or use his doppelgangers to mislead and elude foes if cornered.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer_npedesc1: Creates illusions of himself to trick or attack foes

qualifications.raw: Illusions
Azwraith's illusions have Phantom Rush always toggled on and are ready to rush into the battle upon an order.
Grants Azwraith and his illusions both haste and phase movement upon proc.
Creates a Juxtapose-based illusion that automatically attacks the enemy units Azwraith rushes through.
Number of Illusions per Enemy

Additionally creates an illusions after a certain distance is rushed.

Increases max proc distance.
Number of Illusions Bonus

* The [[toggle]] {{Symbol|Toggle|On}} {{Symbol|Toggle|Off}} component has the following properties:
** Not affected by {{M|silence}} sources.
** Does not interrupt Azwraith's {{M|channeling}} abilities.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# Procs on either an attack command or [[File:Dota2 RMB.png|21px|Right-Click]] on a {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy, except the following actions:
*#* {{Symbol|Target|Ground}} Ground-targeted commands.
*#* Auto-attacks.
*#* On {{M|allied units|x}}.
*# {{Symbol|bonus cd}}
*#* Grants Azwraith {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|phantom_lancer_phantom_edge_boost}} upon the ability [[cooldown]] proc.
*#* This ability component has the following buff durations, and expires upon whichever happens first:
*#** Upon a successful attack.
*#** Upon Azwraith receiving another order.
*# {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Projectile|Run}}
*#* Grants the following ability effects upon proc:
*#** {{Symbol|Evasion}}
*#*** The evasion proc is determined the attack projectile impact, and uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proc|{{#var:Phantom Rush value3}}|lvl=4}}.
*#**** [[Evasion#Stacking|Stacks]] diminishingly with other evasion sources.
*#*** The bonus evasion is granted immediately, but Azwraith does not dash toward the target, in the following conditions:
*#**** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|{{!}} TargetDistance - PhantomLancerLocation {{!}} ≤ {{#var:Phantom Rush value1}}}}
*#** {{M|Haste movement}}.
*#** {{M|Phase movement}}.
*#** The following actions do not cancel the dash component:
*#*** {{Symbol|Target|No}} Non-targeted ability casts.
*#*** {{M|Doubletap}} or {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} self-targeted ability casts.
*# {{cf|aghnotes}} The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} has two components:
*#* [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
*#** Creates {{ValueColor||{{#var:Phantom Rush type3 value2 agh}}|agh}} {{A|Phantom Lancer|Juxtapose}}-based [[illusions]] corresponding to its current level whenever Azwraith dashes through and comes in contact with enemy units within {{ValueColor||{{#var:Phantom Rush type3 value1 agh}}|agh}} radius centered around Azwraith.
*#* [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]]
*#** Creates {{Code|{{ValueColor||{{#var:Phantom Rush type3 value2 agh}}|agh|x}} + n , MAX(n) {{=}} {{ValueColor||2|agh|x}}}} {{A|Phantom Lancer|Juxtapose}}-based illusions per {{ValueColor||{{#var:Phantom Rush type4 value2 agh}}|agh}}-distance traveled from Azwraith's current position to the targeted enemy unit, for each enemy unit Azwraith come in contact with.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{Symbol|Basic Dispel}}
** The following offensive disable sources [[dispels]] the buff:
*** {{M|Cyclone}} sources.
*** {{M|Hex}} sources.
*** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
*** {{M|Sleep}} sources.
*** {{M|Stun}} sources.
** For other disable sources:
*** {{Symbol|Taunt}}
**** [[Taunt]] sources causes Azwraith to rush toward the taunting unit.
**** Forced attack of taunt sources do not dispel the buff.
*** {{Symbol|Projectile|Run}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** Rushes toward the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy's last known location when the enemy is affected by the following sources:
***** {{M|Fog of War}}.
***** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
***** {{M|Invisible}} sources.

{{Illucraft|name=Phantom Lancer Juxtapose|t=5}}

* Juxtapose procs use {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proc|{{#explode:{{#var:Juxtapose value1}}|/|2}}}} with the following properties:
** {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Procs upon a successful attack, including {{M|instant attack}} sources.
*** Procs on all units, except {{M|buildings}}.
*** {{Symbol|Illusions}}
**** Works for any [[illusions]] that have this passive ability {{Proc|{{#var:Juxtapose type1 value1}}|tal={{#var:Juxtapose type1 value1 tal}}}}.
** {{Symbol|Juxtapose}} {{Symbol|Illusions}}
*** Juxtapose-based illusions attack the enemy unit that it was proc'd from.
*** Hence, the created illusion procs {{A|Phantom Lancer|Phantom Rush}} of its corresponding level within the ability's min and max proc distances.
*** Creates 1 illusion per proc corresponding to Azwraith's {{M|facing angle}}, {{#expr:{{Show|H|Phantom Lancer|collisionsize}}*4}}-distance from the attacked enemy unit's location, with the following summoned direction sequence:
**** [[File:Dota2 South.png|31px|South]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 East.png|31px|East]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 North.png|31px|North]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 West.png|31px|West]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 South.png|31px|South]]
**** {{Symbol|Illusform|1}} or {{Symbol|Illusform|1a}}
*** Has a fixed {{Gold|5}} and {{XP|5}} illusion bounty.
<hr>
* {{cf|shdnotes}} Adds an active component to Juxtapose, with two components.
** Neither affects Azwraith's current movement orders nor attack orders upon cast.
** Recasting the ability refreshes both independent components' duration.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px]] {{Symbol|Juxtapose}} {{Symbol|Illusions}} {{Code|[[illusion]]}}
*** Creates the Juxtapose-based illusion at Azwraith current location.
*** Issues a {{Symbol|Target|Point}} point-targeted attack command {{Code|1000-distance}} away, accordingly to Azwraith's current {{M|facing angle}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Invisible}}
*** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|phantom_lancer_juxtapose_invisibility}}
**** The [[invisibility]] applied has an {{Symbol|bonus instant}} instant {{M|fade time}}.
**** Grants {{M|phase movement}} while fully invisible.
**** Interrupts Azwraith's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.
**** Recasting the ability refreshes the buff duration.
**** Azwraith can pick up or drop items without breaking invisibility.
**** The invisibility breaks upon his {{M|attack point}}, or the abilities' {{M|cast point}}.

{{Gamedesc
| image = {{#var:Juxtapose icon0}}
| desc = Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for 8 seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last 4 seconds.
}}
* {{Symbol|Illusions}}
** The spawn distance is defined as:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Caster[[Collision Size|ColSize]] × 4}}
*** For Azwraith, the illusion spawn distance is {{#expr:{{Show|H|Phantom Lancer|collisionsize}}*4}}.
<hr>
* {{cf|shdnotes}} Creates a Juxtapose-based [[illusion]] and caches it at Azwraith's {{M|fountain}} upon acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Shard|text=ability upgrade}} with the following properties:
*** {{M|Cannot act}}.
*** {{M|Hidden}}
*** Uncontrollable
*** Sets its {{M|vision}} range to 0.
*** Toggles {{A|Radiance|Burn}} {{Symbol|Toggle|Off}}.
** The ability effects are applied as follows on the Juxtapose-based illusion:
**# {{M|Teleports}} the created illusion to Azwraith's current position, and no longer disables it upon cast.
**# Recaches the Juxtapose-based illusion at the fountain, or at {{Code|[[Wikipedia:Cartesian coordinate system|(0, 0)]]}}, for the next ability cast.
** The cached mechanism affects the following things:
*** The illusion is not {{M|invulnerable}} during its split time.
*** The illusion's {{M|attributes}} and stats corresponds to whenever the ability was last cast.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Has a chance to create an illusion of himself per attack.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. These images last for a shorter duration.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: The illusion has a different hue when juxtaposed with regular images of Azwraith's self.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value:
Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for a duration while creating an illusion to take its place.

Grants self bonus movement speed while active.

fields.name: interacts
mechanics
fields.value:
{{Illucraft|name=Phantom Lancer Juxtapose|t=5}}

* Juxtapose procs use {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proc|{{#explode:{{#var:Juxtapose value1}}|/|2}}}} with the following properties:
** {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Procs upon a successful attack, including {{M|instant attack}} sources.
*** Procs on all units, except {{M|buildings}}.
*** {{Symbol|Illusions}}
**** Works for any [[illusions]] that have this passive ability {{Proc|{{#var:Juxtapose type1 value1}}|tal={{#var:Juxtapose type1 value1 tal}}}}.
** {{Symbol|Juxtapose}} {{Symbol|Illusions}}
*** Juxtapose-based illusions attack the enemy unit that it was proc'd from.
*** Hence, the created illusion procs {{A|Phantom Lancer|Phantom Rush}} of its corresponding level within the ability's min and max proc distances.
*** Creates 1 illusion per proc corresponding to Azwraith's {{M|facing angle}}, {{#expr:{{Show|H|Phantom Lancer|collisionsize}}*4}}-distance from the attacked enemy unit's location, with the following summoned direction sequence:
**** [[File:Dota2 South.png|31px|South]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 East.png|31px|East]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 North.png|31px|North]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 West.png|31px|West]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 South.png|31px|South]]
**** {{Symbol|Illusform|1}} or {{Symbol|Illusform|1a}}
*** Has a fixed {{Gold|5}} and {{XP|5}} illusion bounty.
<hr>
* {{cf|shdnotes}} Adds an active component to Juxtapose, with two components.
** Neither affects Azwraith's current movement orders nor attack orders upon cast.
** Recasting the ability refreshes both independent components' duration.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px]] {{Symbol|Juxtapose}} {{Symbol|Illusions}} {{Code|[[illusion]]}}
*** Creates the Juxtapose-based illusion at Azwraith current location.
*** Issues a {{Symbol|Target|Point}} point-targeted attack command {{Code|1000-distance}} away, accordingly to Azwraith's current {{M|facing angle}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Invisible}}
*** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|phantom_lancer_juxtapose_invisibility}}
**** The [[invisibility]] applied has an {{Symbol|bonus instant}} instant {{M|fade time}}.
**** Grants {{M|phase movement}} while fully invisible.
**** Interrupts Azwraith's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.
**** Recasting the ability refreshes the buff duration.
**** Azwraith can pick up or drop items without breaking invisibility.
**** The invisibility breaks upon his {{M|attack point}}, or the abilities' {{M|cast point}}.

fields.name: miscnotes
fields.value:
{{Gamedesc
| image = {{#var:Juxtapose icon0}}
| desc = Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for 8 seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last 4 seconds.
}}
* {{Symbol|Illusions}}
** The spawn distance is defined as:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Caster[[Collision Size|ColSize]] × 4}}
*** For Azwraith, the illusion spawn distance is {{#expr:{{Show|H|Phantom Lancer|collisionsize}}*4}}.
<hr>
* {{cf|shdnotes}} Creates a Juxtapose-based [[illusion]] and caches it at Azwraith's {{M|fountain}} upon acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Shard|text=ability upgrade}} with the following properties:
*** {{M|Cannot act}}.
*** {{M|Hidden}}
*** Uncontrollable
*** Sets its {{M|vision}} range to 0.
*** Toggles {{A|Radiance|Burn}} {{Symbol|Toggle|Off}}.
** The ability effects are applied as follows on the Juxtapose-based illusion:
**# {{M|Teleports}} the created illusion to Azwraith's current position, and no longer disables it upon cast.
**# Recaches the Juxtapose-based illusion at the fountain, or at {{Code|[[Wikipedia:Cartesian coordinate system|(0, 0)]]}}, for the next ability cast.
** The cached mechanism affects the following things:
*** The illusion is not {{M|invulnerable}} during its split time.
*** The illusion's {{M|attributes}} and stats corresponds to whenever the ability was last cast.

license.scope: Text only; media licenses are separate.

abilities: Juxtapose floods the fight with an endless army of self-replicating illusions.
Mjollnir, Radiance, Ravage, and Eblade hard-counter his illusion army.
items: Mjollnir / Maelstrom's chain lightning clears Phantom Lancer's illusions.
Heaven's Halberd disarms melee Phantom Lancer for several seconds.
Ghost Scepter makes you immune to Phantom Lancer's physical attacks.
Force Staff creates distance from melee Phantom Lancer.
A dispel plus illusions and attack speed.
Huge stats and a healing-cutting slow.
A silencing burst with true strike and crit.
Evasion, agility, and big attack speed.
